title: V41 shared module split and render-shell migration
scope: Split ymir-vue-shared.js into focused runtime modules while preserving the public window.YmirVueShared API.
Remove template bridge usage from template-heavy Vue batches and migrate them to renderBody / renderActions / shared shell.
Remove raw createApp fallback from core tools batch so app mounting is centralized through mountConfiguredToolApp.

checks.node_check: passed for all ymir-vue scripts, home dashboard, i18n, ui, CSP report, and Vercel skip script
checks.module_smoke: passed for split shared modules and public YmirVueShared API
checks.app_smoke: passed for 12 Vue batch scripts with mocked Vue/Element Plus mount path

remaining_architecture_work: Core ymir-vue-tools-app.js is still a large complex batch, although mounting is centralized.
A tools manifest generator can still be introduced to generate loader mappings, sitemap data, and homepage directory data from one source.
Historical report JSON files still document older phases and may contain old version names as audit history.
